projects.project_name: Multi-Vendor Marketplace Split Payments & Escrow Orchestration
projects.problem: Manual agency payouts and refund processing caused heavy operational overhead and checkout drop-offs.
projects.discovery: Mapped multi-party payment models and identified 18% cart drop-offs from lack of flexible escrow splits.
projects.technical_context: Integrated MangoPay and Adyen APIs to enable multi-party escrow, automated split payments, real-time KYC, and wallet balance orchestration.
actions: Authored end-to-end PRDs and API sequence diagrams for automated escrow funding and disbursement.
Designed fallback retry mechanics between Adyen and MangoPay to guarantee high transaction success.
results: Reduced transaction drop-offs by 18% across reservations.

projects.problem: High customer cancellation rates driven by rigid post-checkout order state and user behavioral friction.
projects.discovery: Led root-cause analysis using Mixpanel, New Relic, and production data, uncovering behavioural and payment-related cancellation drivers.
projects.technical_context: Translated insights into a 30-minute Edit Order capability for delivery slots, promotions, and additional products; combined improvements contributed to a 33% reduction in cancellations.
actions: Uncovered cancellation root causes across checkout steps, payment failures, and delivery slot mismatches.
Specified and delivered 30-minute customer post-checkout Edit Order workflow.
results: Contributed to a 33% reduction in order cancellations.
Significantly improved customer retention and reduced friction.

projects.problem: Customers lacked flexible multi-tender payment options when combining loyalty points, wallet balance, and cards.
projects.discovery: Mapped checkout failure patterns and customer requests for combined loyalty points and card payment checkout.
projects.technical_context: Delivered multi-source payment flows combining Adyen cards, Apple Pay, COD, wallet balance, Smiles points, and promotions, defining adjustment and refund behaviour across substitutions, out-of-stock items, cancellations, and changing order values.
actions: Defined split payment rules and webhook handlers across multiple tender types.
Architected automated refund and adjustment logic for item substitutions.
results: Seamless multi-source payment flows in production.
Streamlined reconciliation and minimized payment failure support tickets.
verified_metrics: Multi-source tender combination across 6 payment methods

projects.problem: Fragmented payment methods and lack of open banking / real-time verification led to high drop-offs.
projects.discovery: Identified high transaction costs and drop-offs during manual bank account entry and traditional card checkout.
projects.technical_context: Owned end-to-end integration of multiple payment methods and Open Banking across web, iOS, and Android, including Plaid (Open Banking), Adyen (cards), Apple Pay, Tabby (BNPL), Etisalat Payment Gateway, UTAP, Careem Pay, COD, and wallet/loyalty points. Defined webhook event schemas, transaction data validation, refund/adjustment logic, and reconciliation flows.
actions: Defined webhook event schemas and transaction data validation protocols.
Managed compliance auditing and automated reconciliation flows across web and mobile.
results: Improved payment success rate and reduced payment-related support tickets.
Enabled secure, real-time Open Banking bank account verification.

projects.problem: Need to embed the grocery eCommerce experience natively inside a major partner super-app with full state parity.
projects.discovery: Analyzed SDK interface points, user authentication handshakes, and attribution leakage.
projects.technical_context: Led UAT and cross-functional delivery of an embedded grocery experience within a partner super-app, validating address synchronization, loyalty points, promotions, notifications, SDK order attribution, and cross-platform data integrity.
actions: Coordinated SDK test specifications and cross-platform release criteria.
Validated real-time address synchronization and loyalty attribution.
results: Successful super-app launch with end-to-end data integrity.
Seamless embedded grocery ordering for millions of super-app users.

projects.problem: Manual tracking of stuck orders caused fulfillment delays and SLA breaches.
projects.discovery: Audited order transition timestamps and identified key bottleneck states in order fulfillment.
projects.technical_context: Automated SLA-based escalation across Pending, In Progress, Picking, Checkout, and En Route states using role-based IVR triggers, up to three retry attempts, and Slack escalation for unresolved orders, reducing reliance on manual operational monitoring.
actions: Designed state machine escalation rules and automated role-based IVR calling.
Integrated instant Slack alerts with order context for edge-case resolutions.
results: Eliminated manual monitoring bottlenecks and prevented order state stalls.
Maintained 99% SLA compliance across fulfillment operations.
verified_metrics: 3 automated retry attempts with IVR triggers

projects.problem: Uneven order distribution caused severe peak-hour capacity overloads and idle off-peak slots.
projects.discovery: Mined 12 months of historical order logs and slot utilization datasets using Python.
projects.technical_context: Analysed 12 months of historical order data using Python to identify delivery-slot, weekday, and seasonal demand patterns, generating capacity-planning insights to better align operational availability with customer demand.
actions: Built predictive slot demand models and capacity visualization dashboards.
Informed dynamic slot availability and capacity allocation parameters.
results: Optimized fleet capacity and smoothed peak-hour fulfillment strain.

projects.problem: Out-of-stock items created fulfillment delays and customer dissatisfaction.
projects.discovery: Identified that picker wait times for customer response averaged over 15 minutes, causing cascading SLA failures.
projects.technical_context: Delivered a substitution workflow connecting customer preferences with Picker operations through call, WhatsApp, and item-removal options, including relevant product alternatives and a six-minute response/fallback mechanism to balance customer choice with fulfilment SLAs.
actions: Specified real-time communication channels (Call, WhatsApp, In-App) for substitutions.
Established a 6-minute fallback window to safeguard fulfillment SLAs.
results: Balanced customer choice with operational fulfillment speed.
Decreased picker wait idle time while maintaining high customer satisfaction.
verified_metrics: Multichannel substitution via Call, WhatsApp, and In-App

projects.candidate_role: Tech Support Manager / Technical Project Manager
projects.problem: High support ticket volumes and slow resolution times impacted customer satisfaction.
projects.discovery: Audited 500+ daily tickets; identified repetitive defect signatures and lack of automated categorization.
projects.technical_context: Implemented structured ticket classification and escalation workflows for 500+ daily support tickets, achieving 99% SLA compliance and reducing average resolution time by 35% through data-driven operational improvements.
actions: Established automated ticket classification workflows and severity tagging.
Created closed-loop root-cause feedback directly into engineering bug triage.
results: Achieved 99% SLA compliance on 500+ daily tickets.
Reduced average incident resolution time by 35%.
